decisionsTitle: The volunteer badge's space for the name — «Spațiul pentru nume (% din înălțime)», the bands at the top sharing what it leaves (amending §764 and §776)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-17, four days before Saturday's race,** looking at the volunteers' badge preview at 90 × 100 mm — the blue header band, the orange role band with «VOLUNTAR», then «Nume:» with the club's pale logo under it — and trying 90 × 130 mm: «vreau un spațiu mai mare pt nume aici»; then: «pare ca proportiile se pastreaza». Every row of a badge was a fixed share of its height (§764: the header 27 %, the role's band 30 %, the writing area the rest, the telephone's and the free-text rows 10 % each when shown, §776), so a taller badge grew the bands as much as the name's space.

**Decision.**

- **One new key in the badge's design, `nameSpacePct` — «Spațiul pentru nume (% din înălțime)»:** a whole number from 43 to 80, 43 by default (`BADGE_NAME_SPACE`, `DEFAULT_BADGE_NAME_SPACE`). It is the share of the badge's content height — inside the 2 mm white border — that the white writing area takes («Nume:», its line, the marker's space, the watermark) before the telephone's row and the free-text line take theirs. The header band and the role's band share what is left in their own 27 : 30 (`badgeRows`, through `badgeBandsScale`): at 60 the two bands take 40 % of the height instead of 57 %, the name's space 60 %; at 80, 20 % and 80 %. The telephone's and the free-text rows keep their 10 % each whatever the share.
- **43 draws today's badge, exactly.** 43 is 100 − 27 − 30: the share the writing area has always had. At 43 — chosen, or absent from a design saved before the key — the code takes the path it always took: the bands keep `BADGE_LAYOUT`'s shares as they are, never multiplied by a factor that is one only in theory (`badgeBandsScale` answers null), and the bands' words keep their least sizes. Every badge of every size, in both modes, «fără rol», with and without a category, the free text, the telephone, the marker and the watermark, draws byte for byte what it drew: §962's snapshot is unchanged, and the layout, the picture's markup and every call the sheet makes, at every size the bounds allow in 10 mm steps, are held to a fingerprint written on the code before the key (`badge-type-unchanged.test.ts`, `GRID_BEFORE`).
- **The bands' words shrink with the bands.** Their largest sizes were already shares of their band's height; past 43 their least sizes — the title's and the role's name's 6 points, «VOLUNTAR»'s — are multiplied by the bands' own factor too, so no line is ever taller than its band, nothing spills over the writing area, and no title, «VOLUNTAR» or role's name is cut with «…» where the badge at 43 is not cut (a category stays whole, §962). The pad — the room inside the bands' ends and round the writing area — stays a share of the header (§764, capped at the 100 mm badge's), so it shrinks with the header. At 80 % on the smallest badges the bands' words are small, 2 to 4 points on 60 × 30 mm; the preview shows it before anything is saved.
- **The squeeze and the save's refusal work as they did, on the new shares.** The writing area never has less than 10 mm (`BADGE_WRITING_MIN`): where a small badge leaves it less, the two bands give up their share in proportion, and a size where they would keep under four fifths of their natural height at that share is refused at the save (`badgeSizeRefusal`, `BADGE_BANDS_MIN_SHARE`), the sentence naming the least height at that share — with the free-text line and the telephone, 34 mm at 43, 32 mm at 45, none from 50 on. More space for the name never refuses a size the default accepts.
- **The form.** A native number box, 43 to 80 in whole steps (`inputMode=numeric`), first in the fold «Locul pentru nume», with one help line: «Cât din înălțimea ecusonului rămâne albă pentru nume. Mai mult = benzile de sus mai mici. 43 = ca acum.» The fold's closed line names the share when it is not 43 («Spațiu pentru nume 60%»). The preview follows the unsaved number, as it follows every box: its address carries `nameSpacePct`. The save refuses anything but a whole number from 43 to 80 — 42, 81, 60.5, an empty box — naming the box and keeping every box as typed, never keeping 43 behind the person's back; a form from before the box posts none, which saves 43.
- **Read forgivingly.** A design saved before the key reads 43, never named; a stored value of the wrong type or out of the bounds reads 43, and the fold says a value could not be read (`badgeDesignDropped`) — never a refusal on read. The event file carries it under `badges.design.nameSpacePct`, a file made before it reading 43, and an import's diff names it («Ecuson: spațiul pentru nume (% din înălțime)»); a copy of the event keeps it.
- `BADGE_DRAWING_VERSION` is 4, so every stamped picture's address changes once. No migration: the design is the event's JSON column.

**Not in this change:** separate controls for the header's and the role band's heights; a band of fixed height in millimetres; the bibs.

**Seen, and left as it is:** the club's logo is 0.68 of the header's height at the lockup's own proportion, so on a narrow, tall badge it fills the header's width: at 43, from about 60 × 100 mm the title beside it is cut to «…» alone, and from about 60 × 120 mm the logo reaches past the content into the white border — past the badge's edge on taller ones, which only the taller badges allow. A larger space for the name makes the header, and so the logo, smaller; capping the logo's width is a question for the owner, not this change.

**The drawing's version.** The space for the name and the logo's size and place (§969) were built side by side, each raising the badge drawing's version from 3 to 4; the logo's was released first, so this one takes 5 (`BADGE_DRAWING_VERSION`), and every stamped picture is drawn again.
changelogLine: - **More room for the name on the volunteers' badges** — «Spațiul pentru nume (% din înălțime)», first in «Locul pentru nume», takes 43 to 80: the higher the number, the lower the two bands at the top and the larger the white space where the name is written; 43 is the badge as before. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given «Cum arată ecusonul», then «Locul pentru nume» opens with «Spațiul pentru nume (% din înălțime)» — a native number box from 43 to 80 in whole steps with one help line, the fold's closed line naming the share when it is not 43 («Spațiu pentru nume 60%») — and the preview follows the unsaved number; «Salvează ecusonul» keeps it in `events.badge_design` as `nameSpacePct` and audits the key changed; anything but a whole number from 43 to 80 is refused naming the box with every box kept, and a form without the box saves 43; a design stored, or an event file made, before the key reads 43, and a stored value of the wrong type or out of the bounds reads 43 and is named beside the fold — never a throw; the key travels in the event's file under `badges.design`, the diff naming it, and in a copy of the event (2026-11-17, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a badge design whose space for the name is past 43, then the writing area takes that share of the badge's content height before the telephone's and the free-text rows take their own, and the header band and the role's band share the rest in their 27 : 30; the writing area never has less than 10 mm, the bands giving up their share in proportion where a small badge needs it, and the save refuses a size where they would keep under four fifths of their height at that share, naming the least height at that share; the bands' words shrink with their bands — never taller than their band, never cut with «…» where the badge at 43 is not cut, the category whole — and at every size the designer accepts the marker's and the name's areas keep their least widths; the PDF sheet and the picture draw the same rows and the same words at the same sizes (2026-11-17, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a badge design whose space for the name is 43 — chosen, or absent from a design stored before the key — then every badge prints exactly what it printed before, at every size the bounds allow: the same layout, the same picture and the same calls to the PDF (2026-11-17, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: more room for the name on the volunteers' badges («Spațiul pentru nume», 43–80 %)
